label: mangrove reference extent (GMW 2020)
input_description: WorldCover 2020 Sentinel-2 annual median GeoTIFF; four bands B02/B03/B04/B08; RGB channels 3/2/1 divided by 10000
limitations: Experimental replication of GMW 2020 map-derived mangrove reference labels on a small site-disjoint sample. Not independent field ground truth. Two training sites only; domain shift, residual cloud/composite artefacts and reference-map errors remain. Use matching 2020 annual-composite inputs. No carbon, certification or credit issuance claim.
